description:
# 1.0.1

Compatibility fix release for Morphe.

Highlights:

- Rebuilds the patch bundle with morphe-patcher 1.5.1 so Morphe Manager and Morphe CLI can load patch metadata correctly.
- Fixes the source showing 0 patches and 0 versions when importing the 1.0.0 bundle.
- Keeps support focused on YouTube 19.16.39.

Credits:

- anddea/revanced-patches
- MorpheApp/morphe-patches and MorpheApp/morphe-manager
- kitadai31/revanced-patches-android6-7
